previous.changeLog:
V2
  Bug Fixes: 
      Resolved an issue where skipping tracks caused playback errors.
      
  New Transparent Styles: 
      Added new styles with "trans" in the name,
      featuring transparent elements whose background colour can now be 
      customized in the mod menu.
      
  Match Button: 
      Added a "Match" button to quickly sync your background colour with your 
      accent colour.
      
  More Fonts: 
      Added a selection of new fonts to choose from.
      
  Solid Color Background: 
      Added an option to use a solid background colour instead of a background image.

current.changeLog:
V3
  Improvements:
      Removed the PowerShell dependency; radio station searches now use
      World of Tanks’ built-in networking API.

  New Styles:
      Added aged copper, dark aluminium and weathered wood backgrounds.
